title: Cost Scales with Change, Not Corpus Size: Incrementally Maintaining an Evolving Semantic Substrate
abstract: arXiv:2608.16621v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrieval-augmented and agentic question-answering systems increasingly re-derive the meaning of a corpus at query time. Put plainly, instead of re-deriving what a corpus means on every question, the work is done once when a document arrives and is thereafter merely consulted -- a compiler, not an interpreter, of meaning. An alternative is to compile that meaning once, at ingest time, into a compact, queryable semantic substrate and maintain it as the corpus evolves. The central objection is maintenance cost: rebuilding a truncated singular value decomposition (SVD) on every change appears prohibitive, and a change of embedding model seems to force a full re-embedding. We argue and show empirically that maintenance cost scales with the amount of change, not corpus size. On a controlled synthetic pilot (dimension 256, rank 32, a corpus grown from 3,000 to 9,000 documents over 50 update events), incremental low-rank updates were 33.7 times

translated_title: 成本随变化而非语料库规模变化：增量维护演化中的语义基底
translated_abstract: 摘要：检索增强和代理式问答系统在查询时越来越频繁地重新推导语料库的含义。简而言之，与其在每个问题上重新推导语料库的含义，不如在文档到达时一次性完成这项工作，之后仅需查阅——这是意义的编译器，而非解释器。另一种方案是在摄取时一次性将该含义编译为紧凑、可查询的语义基底，并在语料库演化时维护它。主要的反对理由是维护成本：每次变化时重建截断奇异值分解（SVD）似乎代价高昂，而嵌入模型的更换似乎迫使全面重新嵌入。我们论证并通过实验表明，维护成本随变化量而非语料库规模变化。在一个受控的合成试点（维度256，秩32，语料库在50次更新事件中从3,000篇文档增长至9,000篇）中，增量低秩更新速度快了33.7倍。
tldr: 本文提出语义基底的增量维护方法，证明维护成本随变化量而非语料库规模增长，通过增量低秩更新显著降低更新开销。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes incremental maintenance of semantic substrates, demonstrating that maintenance cost scales with the amount of change rather than corpus size, with incremental low-rank updates achieving 33.7x speedup.
